command:
set -euo pipefail; REPO=/workspace/clay-global-research-entity; RUN=/workspace/qwen06-gpt56sol-direct; VENV=/cache/clay-qwen06-venv; HFCACHE=/cache/huggingface-qwen06; HEAD=$(git -C "$REPO" rev-parse HEAD); test -f "$REPO/tools/trigger1_local_qwen06_midlayer_causal_execute.py"; if [ -e "$RUN" ]; then git -C "$REPO" worktree remove --force "$RUN" 2>/dev/null || rm -rf "$RUN"; fi; git -C "$REPO" worktree add --detach "$RUN" "$HEAD" >/dev/null; mkdir -p "$HFCACHE" "$RUN/out"; if [ ! -x "$VENV/bin/python" ]; then python3 -m venv "$VENV"; fi; cat > "$RUN/run_qwen.sh" <<'EOS'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
RUN=/workspace/qwen06-gpt56sol-direct
VENV=/cache/clay-qwen06-venv
HFCACHE=/cache/huggingface-qwen06
cd "$RUN"
"$VENV/bin/python" -m pip install -q --upgrade pip wheel setuptools
if ! "$VENV/bin/python" -c 'import torch,transformers,huggingface_hub,safetensors,accelerate' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  "$VENV/bin/python" -m pip install -q --upgrade torch transformers huggingface_hub safetensors accelerate
fi
unset OPENAI_API_KEY OPENAI_API_KEYS ANTHROPIC_API_KEY ANTHROPIC_API_KEYS GROQ_API_KEY GROQ_API_KEYS MISTRAL_API_KEY MISTRAL_API_KEYS NVIDIA_API_KEY NVIDIA_API_KEYS NVIDIA_NIM_API_KEY NGC_API_KEY OPENROUTER_API_KEY OPENROUTER_API_KEYS TOGETHER_API_KEY TOGETHER_API_KEYS HF_TOKEN HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN HUGGINGFACE_HUB_TOKEN || true
export HF_HUB_DISABLE_IMPLICIT_TOKEN=1 HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 MKL_NUM_THREADS=2 HF_HOME="$HFCACHE"
set +e
"$VENV/bin/python" tools/trigger1_local_qwen06_midlayer_causal_execute.py --output-dir "$RUN/out" --cache-dir "$HFCACHE"
rc=$?
set -e
echo "$rc" > "$RUN/out/exit_code.txt"
exit "$rc"
EOS
chmod +x "$RUN/run_qwen.sh"; nohup "$RUN/run_qwen.sh" > "$RUN/out/execution.log" 2>&1 < /dev/null & PID=$!; echo "QWEN_LAUNCHED=PASS"; echo "pid=$PID"; echo "source_head=$HEAD"; echo "source_dirty=$(git -C $RUN status --porcelain | wc -l)"; echo "run=$RUN"; echo "log=$RUN/out/execution.log"; echo "result=$RUN/out/trigger1_local_activation_api_result.json"
